facts.text: The user wants a non-dating in-person social activities app focused on meeting friends and their friends in person to expand a social network.
The user wants the app to coordinate both 1-1 and group activities.
The user wants the app to support activities such as grabbing drinks.
The user wants the app to support activities such as pickup sports games.
The user wants a few personas that describe a range of diverse people for generating user stories.
